entries.title: Candy Glass Above the Clouds
entries.description: Three Hearts City on a soft white cloud in a beautiful clear light-blue sky. Red, green and purple blocks are shiny translucent hard candy, with rounded glossy edges, colored refraction and tiny trapped bubbles. The cloud is white rather than pink carnival candy.
entries.scene: Place the actual original whole map on one beautiful broad fluffy WHITE CLOUD, ivory white sunlit top and subtle cool blue shadows underneath, floating in a vast BEAUTIFUL LIGHT BLUE daytime sky with a few soft distant white clouds. No carnival, no balloons, no ocean, no pink twilight. The original slabs, posts and bridges are all delicious-looking SHINY SEE-THROUGH CANDY GLASS in THREE vibrant colors: cherry RED, emerald/lime GREEN and grape PURPLE. Distribute these by existing structural clusters and pieces, with green posts/red slabs on some clusters, purple posts/green slabs on others and ruby/purple variation on low pavilions; the original abstract building forms remain clearly distinguishable. Material looks biteable like thick polished fruit drops or translucent gummy-hard-candy hybrid: saturated translucent BODY with lighter edges, slight soft bevels, internal little bubbles, subtle syrupy striations, believable colored refraction and a few small bright specular highlights. It MUST actually look see-through, not opaque painted candy, opaque frosting or metallic. You can see the neighboring structure silhouettes through thicker colored pieces, with stronger saturation in thick edges. Tops also made of candy glass for this ART exploration: keep surface contours and edge highlights legible. Sparse rounded sugar beads only at a few outside joints, no heavy decoration. Strong clean sunlight, gentle soft contact shadows on white cloud. Main focus bright blue sky, white cloud, juicy red green purple transparent pieces.
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Actual Unity game map art concept, "Candy Glass Above the Clouds". Attached image is the actual Three Hearts City map GEOMETRY REFERENCE. Keep recognizable layout, counts and silhouettes of towers, OPEN rectangular floor slabs, posts, spiral/catch structure shapes, low pavilions, bridges, floor holes and level heights. User wants color/material/environment change, not literal architecture.
ONE high-quality landscape concept board, main immersive map scene occupies left 78%, three beautifully rendered close-up detail insets occupy right 22%: 1 red candy-glass slab edge, 2 green candy-glass column with internal bubbles, 3 purple candy-glass bridge/slab intersection. Put a small elegant title "Candy Glass Above the Clouds" in upper left, no oversized label hiding map. Macro details demonstrate actual transparency, thickness, refraction, smooth glossy candy texture. Playful Unity 3D game style with delicious light and material polish; simple abstract shapes preserved.

No carnival, no balloons, no ocean, no pink twilight. The original slabs, posts and bridges are all delicious-looking SHINY SEE-THROUGH CANDY GLASS in THREE vibrant colors: cherry RED, emerald/lime GREEN and grape PURPLE. It MUST actually look see-through, not opaque painted candy, opaque frosting or metallic. You can see the neighboring structure silhouettes through thicker colored pieces, with stronger saturation in thick edges. NO enclosed buildings, new walls/windows, extra giant towers, paths or railings. Do not reproduce debugging labels. Need visually convincing red green purple light transmission, glassy clear colored edges. Footer small: "AI MATERIAL CONCEPT • NOT UNITY CAPTURE".

entries.title: Candy Glass on a Tiny Moon
entries.description: The same Three Hearts City and red/green/purple candy-glass materials on a small cratered moon, with a curved pale-gray limb, deep starry space and a distant blue planet. A broad gentle cap under the original structures keeps the layout recognizable.
entries.scene: Place the SAME actual whole-map layout on top of a TINY ROUND MOON, so the pale gray curved lunar horizon and strongly rounded spherical limb are clearly visible below and around the map: a charming little-planet diorama, NOT a giant flat gray island. The original map occupies a broad gently curved nearly level cap on the upper moon, and the tiny moon sphere is visible below; structures retain their original upright axis and bridge connections, not wrapped radially around the sphere. Moon is fine powdery ivory-gray regolith with shallow impact crater textures and a few distant small rocks OUTSIDE routes. Dark midnight-blue space backdrop with fine scattered stars and a distant small blue planet on one side, sunlit pale crescent light on moon's edge; ample soft fill so bottom routes stay readable. The SAME RED GREEN PURPLE translucent biteable CANDY-GLASS blocks: ruby red, emerald/lime green and grape purple, varied by cluster, thick glossy slightly softened edges, tiny trapped bubbles, colored refraction. They must look transparent polished fruit-candy chunks rather than opaque plastic, metal or realistic buildings. Moon surface matte and neutral to make the colorful candy shimmer. Sparse sugar-bead exterior joint details. No astronauts, rockets, flags, space buildings, helmets or extra gameplay objects. No new physical craters in paths. All familiar abstract open slab towers and low structures remain the reference.
